entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • vs 2026 missing rename settings #81432
  • don't flag spelling mistakes in decompiler comment line #81431
  • Unexpected behavior for lock on `object` type with `yield return` in iterator or async-iterator #81430
  • [EE] [C#14] Unable to evaluate extension members (InvalidCastException) #81429
  • .Net SDK 8.0.415 on ARM64 Mac - sporadic `Process terminated. System.MissingMethodException: Method not found: 'Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.RefKind Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Symbols.RefKindExtensions.GetRefKind(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.SyntaxKind)'` #81418
  • Code style options severity not respected during build using non-en windows #81417

Closed

  • C# editor breaking change in behavior when writing await keyword inside event handler #77848
    Backlog
  • Make `IDE0120` (simplify LINQ expression) a suggestion by default #62673
    Backlog
  • Refactoring suggestion -> Move to new file needs a confirmation dialog #74778
  • Feature Request: Expose ability to query Roslyn about current solution in Visual Studio #32556
    18.3
  • Upgrade to Arcade 9 #71827
    Backlog
  • The value `unset` is not supported by the `csharp_style_namespace_declarations` option #69392
    Backlog
  • Semantic info not showing for operators in relational patterns #60158
    Backlog
  • Offer a codefix for BC40005 #54906
    Backlog
  • Fixer to convert `[MaybeNull]T` to `T?` where applicable #50819
    Backlog
  • refactoring: convert class with auto-properties to record syntax #47598
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • PublicApi txt file changes after resetting public api files for 18.0 #81433
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
  • Add manual merges to feature branch #81428
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81427
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Merge 'main' into 'features/collection-expression-arguments' #81426
    Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: handle the rest of pointer-related operations #81420
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Merged

  • Fix await completion changing void to Task for event handler methods #81347
    VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix comparer in StringTokenMap #81368
  • PublicApi txt file changes for 18.0 #81380
    Needs API Review
  • Fade out portion of linq expression that can be simplified #81419
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81058
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Improve LSP conformance in MS.CA.LanguageServer #81174
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Fix API name in data string literal spec #81422
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Feature - String Literals in Data Section as UTF8, Next
  • Improve 'else' indentation in a couple more cases #81411
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Merge 'main' into features/collection-expression-arguments #81392
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: require unsafe for some pointer operations #81240
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Updated

  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Report ERR_PatternWrongType for Union matching scenarios #81352
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Do not report parse errors for '#:' in miscellaneous files #81385
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Reduce cascading errors when record inherits from non-record #81293
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Do not copy hoisted locals or parameters unnecessarily #81227
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • EnC: Block additions to MethodImpl table when targeting .NET Framework #81304
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Refactoring Integration Test stage into a template #81383
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Move IDE code over to C# 14. #79835
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix some minor UI errors that were caused by binding failures #81407
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs UX Triage
  • Improve compiler error recovery for null coalesce assignment operator #80907
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Register encoding provider when `GetEncoding` throws `NotSupportedException` #81382
    Area-Compilers
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81409
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix duplicate parameter names in introduce parameter refactoring #81404
    VSCode
